ProjectMetadata.Title: Scientific Calculator
ProjectMetadata.Description: Advanced mathematical calculator for scientific and engineering applications

TechnicalSpecification.Architecture: Monolithic Python application with Streamlit frontend

UserStories.Flow: Select function → Enter input values → Calculate → Display result

SystemFlows.Description: Calculate sin(x) using math library or custom implementation

TechnologyStack.Database: Session state or local CSV files

ProjectStory.Narrative: As a student, I use the scientific calculator to calculate the derivative of a function. I select the derivative function from the Streamlit interface, enter the input values, and the Python backend calculates and displays the result using SymPy. I can also access a history of my previous calculations stored in session state or local files.
